title: San Francisco Earthquake
description:
The **1906 San Francisco earthquake** struck on April 18, 1906, with an estimated magnitude of 7.9. The earthquake and subsequent fires destroyed over 80% of the city.

An estimated 3,000 people died and over 400,000 were left homeless. The disaster prompted major improvements in earthquake science and urban planning.

San Francisco was rebuilt using more modern building techniques and became a model for earthquake-resistant construction.
